name: LATO.2 for Modly
author: DrHepa
description: Run complete LATO.2 end-to-end, vertex-flow, vertex-autoencoder, and topology-flow inference on one mesh.

params_schema.label: Runtime backend
params_schema.tooltip: Auto uses the backend selected during setup. Unavailable choices fail without fallback.

params_schema.label: Precision
params_schema.tooltip: Exact upstream inference is BF16; Float16 is available only when the portable backend declares support.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Random seed forwarded unchanged to LATO.2.

params_schema.label: Data workers
params_schema.tooltip: Upstream defaults to four DataLoader workers. Set zero to disable multiprocessing on constrained Windows or headless hosts.

params_schema.label: Vertex threshold
params_schema.tooltip: V-VAE occupancy threshold.

params_schema.label: V-Flow steps
params_schema.tooltip: Euler sampling steps for vertex generation.

params_schema.label: CFG strength
params_schema.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance strength.

params_schema.label: Time rescale
params_schema.tooltip: V-Flow timestep rescaling factor.

params_schema.label: Target vertices
params_schema.tooltip: Vertex-count conditioning used when input vertex count is disabled.

params_schema.label: Use input vertex count
params_schema.tooltip: Condition on the quantized input vertex count instead of Target vertices.

params_schema.label: Input-count scale
params_schema.tooltip: Multiplier applied to the quantized input vertex count.

params_schema.label: Minimum conditioned vertices
params_schema.tooltip: Lower clamp for scaled input vertex-count conditioning.

params_schema.label: Maximum conditioned vertices
params_schema.tooltip: Upper clamp for scaled input vertex-count conditioning.

params_schema.label: T-Flow steps
params_schema.tooltip: Euler sampling steps for topology generation.

params_schema.label: Edge logit threshold
params_schema.tooltip: T-VAE edge-logit threshold.

params_schema.label: Topology chunk size
params_schema.tooltip: T-VAE decoding chunk size.
